messages:
harpreet: @here Rolling out new L40s dedicated pools in ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) and ap-northeast-3 (Osaka). These are production-grade low-latency pools intended for real-time features. Reservations open now in Console + Reservations API. Docs: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/l40s-apac

lucas: Inventory snapshot: ap-southeast-2 initial = 5 racks across 2 AZs, ap-northeast-3 initial = 3 racks single AZ. Were enabling a soft-priority window for APAC customers for 72 hours to reduce cross-region migration pain.

mei: Question: what does "soft-priority" mean operationally?

harpreet: Good Q  soft-priority = customers with existing APAC reserved capacity or active support agreements get first-provisioning priority during the 72hr window. Everyone else can reserve but provisioning order may be queued. Were not blocking public reservations.

ops_bot: Allocation created: dedicated:l40s:ap-southeast-2 (cap-17909). Policy "dedicated-l40s-apac-soft-priority" pushed to org config.

lucas: Theres a temporary per-customer reservation cap of 3 racks in ap-southeast-2 and 2 racks in ap-northeast-3 during the soft-priority window. Caps expire 72 hours after this message unless extended.

mei: Fallback routing? If a customer needs more capacity now, what do we do?

harpreet: Fallback to compatible H100 instance pools or L40s multi-tenant shared pools in nearby regions. Customers can set a new flag in the reservation payload: "priority_queue": true to opt into the APAC priority provisioning. Example below: 

POST /v1/dedicated/reservations
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "region": "ap-southeast-2",
  "gpu_type": "l40s",
  "racks": 2,
  "commit_term_days": 30,
  "priority_queue": true
}

Provisioning replies include a provisional ETA and an assigned allocation id. If we overflow, fallback instances are used and billed at on-demand rates until the reserved fleet is fully online.

sales_lead: Billing note: reservations started during the soft-priority window will be prorated to provisioning date. Early-access customers with active enterprise contracts may get waived setup fees  see sales for approvals.

solutions: Support plan: Solutions & Customer Success will run 3 migration office hours (EMEA/APAC/NA friendly) this week and provide one 1:1 migration consult for customers reserving >=2 racks in APAC. Invite sent to accounts with APAC traffic.

lucas: Performance note: L40s typically match L40 family perf; expect <10% delta versus shared L40s for most seq lengths. H100 fallback may show 10-40% variance for very long-context workloads.

harpreet: TL;DR: L40s dedicated pools live in ap-southeast-2 + ap-northeast-3, soft-priority provisioning window for APAC existing customers (72hrs), per-customer temporary caps (3/2 racks), reservation API + console live, priority_queue flag available, fallback options and prorated billing apply, migration office hours + consults available. Ping @solutions or reply here for questions. :earth_asia:
